America exists because our Founding Fathers believed in freedom of religion and speech.

250 years later, we have proof that the Biden-Harris Administration targeted traditional Catholics, nuns, and priests.

Sanctuary for criminal aliens.

Repeat offenders back on the streets.

Criminals first and the safety of
Americans last.

Democrat-run cities.

Meaningful change starts with ending sanctuary cities and states.

Sheridan Gorman should be alive today. God bless her family.

Democrats won't fund DHS.

And they refuse to defund fraud in their states.

No homeland security for Americans, and endless taxpayer dollars for criminals.

What a deal.

A couple was only married for 16 days.

An illegal alien truck driver crashed into the couple and killed them.

Then authorities in sanctuary state
Oregon let the alien go.

You can't make this up.

Attacks by Jane’s Revenge on churches and pro-life centers are downplayed.

But Moms for Liberty and Family Research Council are labeled ‘hate groups.’

The Southern Poverty Law Center’s logic.

First, Democrats said there was no fraud and called it a conspiracy.

Now, they're taking credit for President Trump's successful fraud raids and crackdown.

Can't make this stuff up!
foxnews.com/politics/patel-t…
